name: Royer Host only
brick_stack: Royer self-oscillating push-pull power cell + HFT
engineering_gate: 磁性比最大；作 Royer host 基準

name: 3-cell Royer + series secondary
brick_stack: Early 3-way split + 3 Royer power cells + secondary series addition
engineering_gate: 每 Cell 輸入≈58.5 A；有效磁性比由約28降到9.33，但模組化/IPOS本身非 novelty

name: RH1 + Resonant brick
power_throughput: main power still ≈667 W/cell; added reactive power depends on Irms
gain_role: Can assist ZVS and alter conversion gain
engineering_gate: 若 Irms 增加10%，純I²R項約增加21%；必須用saved switching loss抵銷

name: RH1 + Current-fed brick
brick_stack: RH1 + branch current-fed input choke / current shaping
power_throughput: full ≈702 W input/cell passes through current-fed branch
engineering_gate: choke 是 full-current series brick；DCR/core/clamp loss必須先算，不可因能升壓就保留

name: RH1 + Capacitive gain brick
brick_stack: RH1 + switched-cap/flying-cap voltage stacking near X1
gain_role: Shares required voltage gain with magnetic path
engineering_gate: 若在12-V端處理大比例功率，charge-transfer current仍是百安培級；應優先放到已較高電壓節點

name: RH1 + Current-fed + Resonant
brick_stack: 3 Royer cells + current-fed branch + multi-primary/series-secondary magnetic + resonant commutation
engineering_gate: 先算 full-power choke penalty + resonant RMS penalty，再決定值不值得保留 Royer

name: RH1 + Resonant + Capacitive gain after partial step-up
brick_stack: 3 Royer cells + resonant HFT + capacitive stacking placed after first voltage rise
power_throughput: capacitive brick processes selected fraction at >12 V
gain_role: Reduce turns-ratio burden without forcing all cap charge transfer at 12 V
engineering_gate: 比把飛跨電容直接放12-V端合理；需選placement與功率fraction
